charges.label: Registration fee
charges.note: A charge payable to the cooperative. Where an employer deducts contributions at source, it is recovered through that deduction instead.

charges.label: Minimum monthly contribution
charges.note: Your own money, held in your savings. It is not a charge.

charges.label: Monthly administrative fee
charges.note: Recovered from your contribution, or from salary where an employer deducts contributions.

charges.label: Late repayment fine
charges.note: Recorded as a separate obligation. It is not added to your loan balance.

not_charged: Account-maintenance charge beyond the monthly administrative fee
